title: Widening the sidewalk under Chongxin Bridge to be completed within 3 months
summary: A pedestrian walkway beneath Chongxin Bridge in Sanchong District, New Taipei City, is only about 1.8 meters wide, causing difficulty for strollers, wheelchairs, and pedestrians, especially during peak hours. After receiving complaints, New Taipei City Councilor Li Weng-yue coordinated with Sanchong District Office, the New Taipei City Public Works Department, and local village heads to conduct a site inspection. They decided to reallocate road space to widen the walkway to 3 meters, with improvements expected to be completed within three months, enhancing pedestrian safety and accessibility.
body:
A pedestrian walkway beneath Chongxin Bridge in Sanchong District, New Taipei City, is only about 1.8 meters wide, causing difficulty for strollers, wheelchairs, and pedestrians, especially during peak hours. After receiving complaints, New Taipei City Councilor Li Weng-yue coordinated with Sanchong District Office, the New Taipei City Public Works Department, and local village heads to conduct a site inspection. They decided to reallocate road space to widen the walkway to 3 meters, with improvements expected to be completed within three months, enhancing pedestrian safety and accessibility.

Plaintiffs claim supervisors did not conduct full evaluations, instead scoring employees based on output, coding activity, and AI tool usage, which disadvantaged employees unable to accumulate data during protected leave.
body:
A group of current and former Meta employees filed a collective lawsuit alleging the company relied heavily on AI tools and employee monitoring data to decide layoffs in May, disproportionately affecting those who took sick leave, parental leave, or adjusted workloads due to disability. title: Euthanasia referendum sparks debate; doctors and committees face emotional coercion dilemma; Dutch experience warrants caution
summary: The Kuomintang and the People's Party jointly pushed the euthanasia referendum and the abolish non-nuclear policy referendum to second reading in the Legislative Yuan. Experts note the draft includes all psychiatric patients, i.e., persons with physical and mental disabilities, and would be carried out by medical personnel, similar to the Netherlands. Dutch data show a sixfold increase in euthanasia among youths aged 15‑29 due to psychological trauma over five years, leaving committees and doctors vulnerable to emotional coercion.
body:
The Kuomintang and the People's Party jointly pushed the euthanasia referendum and the abolish non-nuclear policy referendum to second reading in the Legislative Yuan. Experts note the draft includes all psychiatric patients, i.e., persons with physical and mental disabilities, and would be carried out by medical personnel, similar to the Netherlands. Dutch data show a sixfold increase in euthanasia among youths aged 15‑29 due to psychological trauma over five years, leaving committees and doctors vulnerable to emotional coercion.

title: After Paying Off Mortgage, Elderly Couple Finds New Burden: Selling Their Long‑Time Home for Greater Convenience
summary: A 73‑year‑old and a 71‑year‑old couple in Japan decided to sell the house they had lived in for 30 years due to high maintenance costs and insufficient income. They moved to a two‑room residence near a station with complete living facilities, greatly reducing upkeep burdens and making daily cleaning and medical visits easier. Experts note that retirement relocation is not about abandoning memories but adjusting lifestyles to physical and financial realities. The case highlights that retirement housing planning should prioritize accessibility and convenience, shifting focus from asset maintenance to quality of life, allowing a lighter, more relaxed senior life.

title: Former school building in Ngau Tau Kok converted to transitional housing
summary: The government continues to utilize vacant urban school buildings for transitional housing. The former Hong Kong Taoist Association Yun Chuen School at On Sin Road, Upper Ngau Tau Kok Estate, will be operated by the Christian Family Service Centre as a social housing project called 'On Ting Estate', expected to provide 120 units for 340 residents. Documents submitted to the Kwun Tong District Council by the Housing Bureau's Transitional Housing Task Force show the project offers various unit sizes, including 2-3 person small units (~17 sqm) and 3-4 person larger units (~25 sqm), plus accessible units (~32 sqm).
body:
The government continues to utilize vacant urban school buildings for transitional housing. The former Hong Kong Taoist Association Yun Chuen School at On Sin Road, Upper Ngau Tau Kok Estate, will be operated by the Christian Family Service Centre as a social housing project called 'On Ting Estate', expected to provide 120 units for 340 residents. Documents submitted to the Kwun Tong District Council by the Housing Bureau's Transitional Housing Task Force show the project offers various unit sizes, including 2-3 person small units (~17 sqm) and 3-4 person larger units (~25 sqm), plus accessible units (~32 sqm).

title: Renai Elementary School in Jiali Completes Safe School Commute Path, Eliminating Vehicle-Pedestrian Conflicts
summary: To enhance safety and convenience for students and pedestrians, the Tainan City Government continues to promote improvements to school zone walking paths, implementing a 'people-first' transportation concept. It helped Renai Elementary School in Jiali District secure NT$6.7 million in funding to complete the 'Second Phase of Annan Road School Commute Path Improvement Project,' which was finished and opened in June this year. The new path successfully resolves previous vehicle-pedestrian conflicts, and its bright, comfortable environment has received unanimous praise from parents, students, and local residents. Education Bureau Director Zheng Xin-hui noted that Renai Elementary proactively released school land, moving the fence inward to create an exclusive pedestrian space over 3 meters wide. At the same time, utilities were consolidated, utility poles affecting movement were relocated, and comprehensive tactile paving for the blind and accessible ramps were installed. Multi-layered greenery, creative-shaped resting benches, and large tree shade were added, combined with a rear small parking lot...
